_comment: Copy to ~/.flywheel/test-slots.json and fill in values
_setup: Create bots at discord.com/developers/applications, channels in Discord server
_role: slot.role selects FLYWHEEL_LEAD_ROLE (cos vs lead — picks the base rule file: cos-lead-rules.md vs department-lead-rules.md). Required.
_identitySource: FLY-153: slot.identitySource selects which GeoForge3D .lead/<dir>/identity.md to source. Allowlist: cos-lead | product-lead | ops-lead. Optional — pre-FLY-153 configs without this field fall back to role mapping (cos→cos-lead, lead→product-lead). MUST be set for slot 3 to load Oliver instead of Peter (mirror cascade coverage requires it).
_fly163: FLY-163: forumChannelId / forumChannelName fields are removed. test-deploy.sh no longer reads them. ProjectConfig strips any deprecated forumChannel key with a warning at load time.
_mirrorChannel: FLY-153: top-level mirrorChannel block is OPTIONAL. Required only for `test-deploy.sh --mode mirror`. Create one shared text channel in the test guild and invite bots flywheel-test-1/2/3 (View Channel + Send Messages + Read Message History). See packages/qa-framework/README.md §Mirror Mode for step-by-step.
_roundtableChannel: FLY-529: top-level roundtableChannel block is OPTIONAL. Required only for `test-deploy.sh --mode roundtable`. Create a shared text channel (mirrors #leads-roundtable) in the test guild. hostSlot's bot ALSO needs Create Public Threads + Send Messages in Threads (the auto-thread manager creates threads). memberSlots = NON-host slot ids the manager adds to each topic thread. triggerMode = any_top_level (easiest for QA) | explicit_prefix | any_lead_mention. Run scripts/setup-roundtable-channel.sh <channel-id> to validate + install. FLY-314 Part-b QA (OPTIONAL, default OFF = byte-compatible): replyInThread (bool) routes a Lead's reply INTO the topic thread; autoContinue (bool) lets thread members continue without @-mentioning each other, bounded by threadBudget (int, OPTIONAL — omit to exercise the shipped backend default 12 per FLY-676; only set it to override) per-thread bot-only anti-loop budget. These set the plugin's FLYWHEEL_ROUNDTABLE_REPLY_IN_THREAD / _THREAD_AUTOCONTINUE / _THREAD_BUDGET on the test Lead pane; leave unset/false for the Phase-1 auto-thread smoke.
_alertChannel: FLY-529: top-level alertChannel block is OPTIONAL. Required only for `test-deploy.sh --alerts`. Create an isolated alert channel (mirrors #flywheel-alerts) and invite the slot bot(s) + repair bot. repairBotTokenEnv defaults to the slot's tokenEnvVar. Run scripts/setup-alert-channel.sh <channel-id> to validate + install.
